— Kaslin Fields, CNCF Ambassador, developer advocate at Google

——Kaslin Fields，CNCF 大使，Google 开发者关系工程师

The ability to administer and monitor a Kubernetes cluster is in high demand. Those who want to demonstrate their credibility and value in the job market hold the Cloud Native Computing Foundation’s Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) certification—proving they can confidently work in a Kubernetes environment. The CKA certification exam isn’t the typical multiple-choice format of other professional certifications. Instead, it’s performance-based, requiring deep knowledge of the tasks under immense time pressure. And the CKA was overhauled in 2025, with an updated curriculum covering new topics including Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and Operators, the Gateway API, and more.

管理和监控 Kubernetes 集群的能力目前市场需求旺盛。那些希望在就业市场证明自身可信度与价值的人，会考取云原生计算基金会（CNCF）的 Certified Kubernetes Administrator（CKA）认证——以此证明自己能够从容地在 Kubernetes 环境中工作。CKA 考试不同于其他专业认证常见的选择题形式，它是基于实操的：要求在巨大的时间压力下，凭借对任务的深入理解来作答。CKA 已于 2025 年全面改版，更新后的大纲涵盖 Custom Resource Definition（CRD）与 Operator、Gateway API 等新主题。

This updated study guide takes you through all the competencies covered in the exam, including new sections reflecting the recent changes. Author Benjamin Muschko also shares his personal experience with preparing for all aspects of the exam.

这本更新版学习指南带你逐一掌握考试覆盖的全部能力项，包括反映近期变化的新增章节。作者 Benjamin Muschko 还分享了他本人备考各环节的经验。

你将学到：

  • Understand the objectives, abilities, and tips and tricks needed to pass the CKA exam理解通过 CKA 考试所需的大纲、能力要求以及应试技巧
  • Explore the ins and outs of the kubectl command-line tool深入探究 kubectl 命令行工具的方方面面
  • Demonstrate competency to perform the responsibilities of a Kubernetes administrator证明自己具备胜任 Kubernetes 管理员职责的能力
  • Solve real-world Kubernetes problems in a hands-on command-line environment在动手命令行环境中解决真实的 Kubernetes 问题
  • Effectively navigate and solve questions during the CKA exam在 CKA 考试中高效定位并解答题目

Benjamin Muschko is a software engineer, consultant, and trainer with more than 20 years of experience in the industry. He specializes in cloud native application development and transformation, container solutions, DevSecOps, and continuous integration/continuous delivery implementations. Ben is an author, conference speaker, and open source advocate.

Benjamin Muschko 是一名软件工程师、顾问与培训师，拥有 20 多年行业经验。他专注于云原生应用开发与转型、容器解决方案、DevSecOps 以及持续集成/持续交付（CI/CD）落地。Ben 同时也是作者、会议讲者和开源倡导者。

Preface前言

Kubernetes has become the de facto standard for container orchestration, with over 96% of organizations using or evaluating Kubernetes according to the CNCF Annual Survey 2023. As organizations increasingly adopt cloud native technologies, the demand for skilled Kubernetes administrators has skyrocketed. The ability to deploy, manage, troubleshoot, and secure Kubernetes clusters is now a critical skill for infrastructure engineers, DevOps professionals, and system administrators worldwide. To provide a standardized way to validate these essential skills, the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF), in collaboration with the Linux Foundation, created the Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) program. Since its launch in 2017, the CKA has become one of the most sought-after certifications in the industry. According to the CNCF Annual Report 2024, over 250,000 professionals have earned CNCF certifications, with the Kubernetes certifications representing the majority of this achievement. The report also highlights that the Kubestronaut program, which recognizes professionals who earn all Kubernetes certifications, reached 1,500 members in its first year alone, demonstrating the strong commitment to comprehensive Kubernetes expertise.

Kubernetes 已成为容器编排的事实标准——根据 CNCF 2023 年度调查，超过 96% 的组织正在使用或评估 Kubernetes。随着各组织越来越多地采用云原生技术，对熟练 Kubernetes 管理员的需求急剧攀升。部署、管理、排查和保护 Kubernetes 集群的能力，如今已成为全球基础设施工程师、DevOps 从业者和系统管理员的关键技能。为了提供一种标准化方式来验证这些必备技能，云原生计算基金会（CNCF）与 Linux 基金会合作创建了 Certified Kubernetes Administrator（CKA）项目。自 2017 年推出以来，CKA 已成为业界最受追捧的认证之一。根据 CNCF 2024 年度报告，已有超过 25 万名专业人士获得 CNCF 认证，其中 Kubernetes 认证占了大多数。报告还强调，表彰通过全部 Kubernetes 认证专业人士的 Kubestronaut 计划，仅第一年就达到 1500 名成员，体现出业界对全面掌握 Kubernetes 专业能力的强烈追求。

The CKA certification validates that you have the skills, knowledge, and competency to perform the responsibilities of a Kubernetes administrator. Unlike traditional multiple-choice exams, the CKA is a rigorous, performance-based test that requires you to solve real-world problems in a live Kubernetes environment under time pressure. With a pass rate historically hovering around 60%, earning this certification demonstrates genuine, hands-on expertise that employers value.

CKA 认证验证你具备履行 Kubernetes 管理员职责所需的技能、知识与胜任力。与传统选择题考试不同，CKA 是一场严格的、基于实操的考试，要求你在时间压力下、在真实运行的 Kubernetes 环境中解决实际问题。其历史通过率长期徘徊在 60% 左右，因此获得该认证证明你拥有雇主看重的、真正的动手实战能力。

This study guide will prepare you to pass the CKA certification exam by covering all topics in the curriculum. We’ll explore cluster architecture, installation and configuration, workload management, networking, storage, and troubleshooting. Throughout this journey, you’ll gain practical experience with command-line tools like kubectl, kubeadm, and helm to learn the best practices that will serve you well both in the exam and in real-world scenarios.

本学习指南将覆盖考试大纲中的全部主题，帮你备考 CKA 认证考试。我们将探讨集群架构、安装与配置、工作负载管理、网络、存储以及故障排查。在这一过程中，你将通过 kubectl、kubeadm、helm 等命令行工具积累实战经验，掌握那些在考试和真实场景中都用得上的最佳实践。

— PDF p.15 —

Who This Book Is For本书适合谁

This book is for system administrators, DevOps engineers, infrastructure architects, and anyone who wants to prepare for the CKA exam. While the content covers all aspects of the exam curriculum, readers should have basic knowledge of Linux, containers, and fundamental Kubernetes concepts.

本书面向系统管理员、DevOps 工程师、基础设施架构师，以及所有希望备考 CKA 考试的人。虽然内容覆盖考试大纲的方方面面，但读者应具备 Linux、容器和 Kubernetes 基本概念的基础知识。

If you are completely new to Kubernetes, I recommend that you first read Kubernetes: Up and Running, 3rd Edition by Brendan Burns, Joe Beda, Kelsey Hightower, and Lachlan Evenson (O’Reilly, 2022) or Kubernetes in Action by Marko Lukša (Manning Publications, 2018).

如果你完全是 Kubernetes 新手，我建议先阅读 Brendan Burns、Joe Beda、Kelsey Hightower、Lachlan Evenson 合著的《Kubernetes: Up and Running》第三版（O’Reilly, 2022），或 Marko Lukša 所著的《Kubernetes in Action》（Manning Publications, 2018）。

The CKA should not be confused with the Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) exam. While there is topic overlap, the CKA focuses on cluster administration, installation, and maintenance tasks rather than application deployment and management. For those interested in the complete Kubernetes certification path, the CNCF offers a certification bundle that includes CKA, CKAD, and CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist).

不要把 CKA 与 Certified Kubernetes Application Developer（CKAD）考试混淆。虽然两者主题有重叠，但 CKA 聚焦于集群管理、安装和维护任务，而非应用的部署与管理。对于希望走完整 Kubernetes 认证路径的人，CNCF 提供了一个认证套餐，包含 CKA、CKAD 和 CKS（Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist）。

In addition to the Kubernetes-specific certifications, the CNCF offers complimentary certifications that validate expertise in cloud native technologies. These industry-recognized certifications also include project-specific options like Prometheus Certified Associate (PCA) and GitOps Certified Associate (CGOA), all featuring hands-on, performance-based exams in command-line environments.

除了 Kubernetes 专属认证外，CNCF 还提供补充性认证，以验证你在云原生技术方面的专长。这些业界认可的认证还包括针对具体项目的选项，如 Prometheus Certified Associate（PCA）和 GitOps Certified Associate（CGOA），它们全部采用命令行环境下的实操、基于表现的考试形式。

What You Will Learn你将学到什么

The content of this book follows the official CKA exam curriculum, covering cluster architecture, installation and configuration, workload management, networking, storage, and troubleshooting. Given the breadth of Kubernetes functionality, it’s impossible to cover every configuration option without duplicating the official documentation. Test takers are encouraged to reference the Kubernetes documentation during the exam, as it’s an allowed resource.

本书内容遵循官方 CKA 考试大纲，涵盖集群架构、安装与配置、工作负载管理、网络、存储和故障排查。鉴于 Kubernetes 功能之广，要想穷尽每一个配置项而不重复官方文档是不可能的。考试允许查阅 Kubernetes 文档，鼓励考生在考试时参考它。

Practical experience is crucial for passing the exam. Each chapter contains a “Sample Exercises” section with practice questions that mirror the exam format. Solutions to these exercises are available in Appendix A.

实战经验对通过考试至关重要。每章都有一个“Sample Exercises”（样题练习）小节，提供模拟考试形式的练习题。这些练习的参考答案见附录 A。

What’s New in the Second Edition第二版更新内容

The CNCF regularly updates the CKA curriculum to keep pace with Kubernetes evolution and industry needs. The curriculum update effective February 18, 2025, brings significant changes that reflect how Kubernetes is actually used in production environments today. The exam now uses Kubernetes v1.33, and this second edition has been completely updated to cover all the new topics while removing outdated content.

CNCF 会定期更新 CKA 大纲，以跟上 Kubernetes 的演进和行业需求。2025 年 2 月 18 日生效的大纲更新带来了重大变化，反映了当今生产环境中 Kubernetes 的实际使用方式。考试现在基于 Kubernetes v1.33，本第二版也已全面更新，覆盖所有新主题，同时删除过时内容。

— PDF p.16 —

Based on the official program changes and CNCF announcements, the next sections list the topics added and removed.

根据官方项目变更和 CNCF 公告，以下小节列出新增和移除的主题。

Topics Added新增主题

Gateway API

Gateway API

A major addition to the curriculum, the Gateway API represents the future of ingress traffic management in Kubernetes. This modern alternative to traditional Ingress resources provides more expressive routing rules, better multitenancy support, and extensible traffic management capabilities. You’ll learn how to implement and manage Gateway resources, HTTPRoutes, and GatewayClasses.

作为大纲的一项重大新增，Gateway API 代表了 Kubernetes 入口流量管理的未来。它是传统 Ingress 资源的现代化替代方案，提供更具表达力的路由规则、更好的多租户支持以及可扩展的流量管理能力。你将学习如何实现和管理 Gateway 资源、HTTPRoute 和 GatewayClass。

Helm

Helm

Package management with Helm is now part of the CKA curriculum. You’ll need to understand how to use Helm for deploying applications, managing releases, and working with Helm charts. This reflects the reality that Helm has become the de facto standard for Kubernetes application packaging.

使用 Helm 进行包管理现在已纳入 CKA 大纲。你需要理解如何用 Helm 部署应用、管理 release，以及使用 Helm chart。这反映了 Helm 已成为 Kubernetes 应用打包事实标准的现实。

Kustomize

Kustomize

Declarative configuration management using Kustomize is now required knowledge. The curriculum covers how to use Kustomize for managing environment-specific configurations without templating, a critical skill for managing applications across multiple environments.

使用 Kustomize 进行声明式配置管理现在是必备知识。大纲涵盖如何用 Kustomize 在不使用模板的情况下管理特定环境的配置——这是跨多个环境管理应用的关键技能。

Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators

Custom Resource Definition（CRD）与 Operator

Understanding how to extend Kubernetes through CRDs and work with operators is now essential. This addition reflects the widespread adoption of the operator pattern in production Kubernetes environments.

理解如何通过 CRD 扩展 Kubernetes、以及如何使用 Operator，现在已成为必备能力。这一新增主题反映了 Operator 模式在生产级 Kubernetes 环境中的广泛采用。

Container Runtime Interfaces

容器运行时接口

The curriculum now includes coverage of extension interfaces like Container Network Interface (CNI), Container Storage Interface (CSI), and Container Runtime Interface (CRI). Understanding these interfaces is crucial for troubleshooting and configuring production clusters.

大纲现在涵盖了各类扩展接口，如容器网络接口（CNI）、容器存储接口（CSI）和容器运行时接口（CRI）。理解这些接口对排查和配置生产集群至关重要。

Expanded CoreDNS coverage

扩展的 CoreDNS 内容

While DNS was always part of the curriculum, there’s now expanded focus on CoreDNS configuration, troubleshooting DNS issues, and understanding service discovery mechanics in detail.

虽然 DNS 一直是大纲的一部分，但现在更加聚焦于 CoreDNS 配置、DNS 问题排查，以及详细理解服务发现机制。

Network policies

网络策略

Network policies are now explicitly mentioned in the curriculum. You’ll need to understand how to define and enforce network policies to control traffic flow between Pods, namespaces, and external endpoints. This addition emphasizes the growing importance of network segmentation and security in multitenant clusters.

网络策略现在被明确写入大纲。你需要理解如何定义和强制执行网络策略，以控制 Pod 之间、namespace 之间以及与外部端点之间的流量。这一新增强调了多租户集群中网络隔离与安全日益增长的重要性。

— PDF p.17 —

Pod admission and scheduling

Pod 准入与调度

The topic “Configure Pod admission and scheduling” has been made more prominent in the curriculum. This includes deeper coverage of scheduling mechanisms, node affinity, taints and tolerations, Pod priority and preemption, and admission controllers. The increased emphasis reflects the complexity of workload placement in production clusters.

“配置 Pod 准入与调度”这一主题在大纲中被提到更突出的位置。它包括对调度机制、节点亲和性、污点与容忍、Pod 优先级与抢占，以及准入控制器的更深入讲解。这种加重反映了生产集群中工作负载放置的复杂性。

Topics Removed移除主题

The competency “Provision underlying infrastructure to deploy a Kubernetes cluster” has been removed, acknowledging that most organizations now use managed Kubernetes platforms rather than provisioning infrastructure from scratch.

“为部署 Kubernetes 集群准备底层基础设施”这一能力项已被移除——这承认了如今大多数组织都使用托管 Kubernetes 平台，而非从零开始搭建基础设施。

Structural Changes结构变化

While the five main domains (Cluster Architecture, Installation and Configuration; Workloads and Scheduling; Services and Networking; Storage; and Troubleshooting) remain the same, the competencies within each domain have been updated to reflect modern practices.

尽管五大考试域（集群架构、安装与配置；工作负载与调度；服务与网络；存储；故障排查）保持不变，但每个域内的能力项都已更新，以反映现代实践。

The exam continues to be performance-based with a 2-hour time limit, but the scenarios now better reflect real-world tasks that administrators face when managing production Kubernetes clusters. Additionally, I’ve included an “Exam Review Guide” in Appendix B that maps all curriculum topics to corresponding chapters and provides quick reference links to the Kubernetes documentation.

考试仍为基于实操形式、限时 2 小时，但现在的场景更贴近管理员在管理生产 Kubernetes 集群时面对的真实任务。此外，我在附录 B 中加入了一份“考试复习指南”，把所有大纲主题映射到对应章节，并提供指向 Kubernetes 文档的快速参考链接。

Part I. Introduction第 I 部分：导论

The introduction part of the book touches on the most important aspects of the exam and orients Kubernetes beginners to the lay of the land without introducing too much complexity.

本书的导论部分涉及考试最重要的方面，并在不过于复杂的前提下，帮助 Kubernetes 初学者了解全局。

The following chapters cover these concepts:

以下章节涵盖这些概念：

  • Chapter 1 discusses the exam objectives, curriculum, and tips and tricks for passing the exam.第 1 章讨论考试目标、大纲以及通过考试的技巧。
  • Chapter 2 is a short and sweet overview on Kubernetes. This chapter summarizes the purpose and benefits of Kubernetes and provides an overview of its architecture and components.第 2 章是对 Kubernetes 的简明概述，总结 Kubernetes 的用途与优势，并概览其架构与组件。
  • Chapter 3 discusses how to interact with a Kubernetes cluster using the command-line tool kubectl. The tool is going to be your only user interface during the exam. We’ll compare imperative and declarative commands and their pros and cons, as well as time-saving techniques for the exam.第 3 章讨论如何使用命令行工具 kubectl 与 Kubernetes 集群交互。考试期间这个工具将是你唯一的用户界面。我们将比较命令式与声明式命令及其优缺点，以及考试中节省时间的技巧。
